# Change summary

Describe user impact, scope, and reason.

## Validation

- [ ] Formatting, lint, and type-check pass.
- [ ] Relevant unit/component/integration/domain tests pass.
- [ ] Production build passes.
- [ ] Database, generated types, OpenAPI, and documentation contracts pass.
- [ ] Changed-content secret/local-path scan passes.
- [ ] New or changed migrations are forward-only and reviewed.
- [ ] Hosted tests are marked `BLOCKED` unless executed against protected staging.
- [ ] Screenshots/evidence are attached for visible UI changes.

## Deployment and rollback

- [ ] Preview URL and deployed commit are recorded.
- [ ] Migration, Edge Function, environment-variable, and data-mutation impact is described.
- [ ] Rollback/forward-fix steps are documented.
- [ ] Production deployment requires the protected environment and release approval.
